pkgmetadata.longdescription: A Wayland screen streaming server: tile-diffed WebP frames over a WebRTC DataChannel to any browser, with the client page embedded in the binary. wlr-screencopy DMA-BUF capture, or PipeWire for GNOME/KDE.

use.flag: Capture through PipeWire and xdg-desktop-portal (GNOME, KDE) in addition to wlr-screencopy
